title: gtfs-jp-monitor-content/1
description: Content signature of a publication's ZIP (feeds/<org_id>/<feed_id>/generations/<uid>/content.json), independent of the analysis key. Equal signatures mean every file holds the same values; see src/gtfs_jp_monitor/signature.py and data-model §4.2.

zip_sha256.description: The ZIP bytes the signature was computed from; it counts only when it equals the analysed ZIP.

files.description: Per ZIP member; null when the ZIP could not be read, so the signature is the ZIP digest.
